sentences.en: On a March afternoon in 1996, the Toronto Raptors, a brand new team in the NBA at the time,
sentences.zh: 1996年3月的一个下午，当时作为NBA全新球队的多伦多猛龙队，
正在对阵芝加哥公牛队。

sentences.en: The Bulls were the best team in the league, and the Raptors were pretty terrible.
sentences.zh: 公牛队是联盟里最强的球队，而猛龙队则相当糟糕。

sentences.en: 36,000 fans showed up that day, and the Raptors actually beat the Bulls.
sentences.zh: 那天有36,000名球迷到场，猛龙队竟然击败了公牛队。

sentences.en: But it was a mostly meaningless game at the end of the season.
sentences.zh: 但这只是赛季末一场基本上没有什么意义的比赛。

sentences.en: And what's so interesting to me about this game isn't who won or how the team's played,
sentences.zh: 这场比赛最让我感兴趣的不是谁赢了，也不是球队的表现，

sentences.en: There's the Bulls, who are just classic NBA.
sentences.zh: 看看公牛队，他们完全是经典的NBA风格。

sentences.en: They've had the same logo since 1966.
sentences.zh: 自1966年以来，他们一直使用同一个标志。

sentences.en: They're wearing their red away jerseys that look basically like every Chicago Bulls jersey ever.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着红色的客场球衣，基本上看起来和历来的芝加哥公牛队球衣一模一样。

sentences.en: It's red with the word Bulls written across the front in black and white lettering.
sentences.zh: 那是红色的，正面用黑白字体写着“公牛”字样。

sentences.en: But then, there's the Toronto Raptors.
sentences.zh: 但接下来是多伦多猛龙队。

sentences.en: The team is wearing their white home uniforms, which have jagged silver and black pinstripes,
sentences.zh: 这支球队穿着他们的白色主场队服，上面有锯齿状的银色和黑色细条纹，

sentences.en: as if they were cut by slashing raptor claws.
sentences.zh: 就好像是被猛龙撕裂的爪子抓破的一样。

sentences.en: And then, across the whole front, there's a giant red basketball-playing dinosaur,
sentences.zh: 然后，在整个胸前，有一个巨大的红色打篮球的恐龙，

sentences.en: who himself is wearing sneakers and a uniform, a totally different uniform.
sentences.zh: 它自己穿着运动鞋和一套完全不同的队服。

sentences.en: And that was just their home uniform.
sentences.zh: 而这还只是他们的主场队服。

sentences.en: The road jerseys that year were even more fun.
sentences.zh: 那年的客场球衣更有意思。

sentences.en: All of this, including the Raptors' name,
sentences.zh: 所有这一切，包括猛龙队的名字，

sentences.en: had been inspired by the Velociraptors in the wildly successful movie Jurassic Park.
sentences.zh: 灵感都来自于大获成功的电影《侏罗纪公园》里的迅猛龙。

sentences.en: But these jerseys got compared to a different, much friendlier 90s dinosaur.
sentences.zh: 但这些球衣却被拿来与90年代另一只更友好、更温和的恐龙作比较。

sentences.en: That's now known as the Barney design because their road uniform was purple.
sentences.zh: 现在这被称为巴尼设计，因为他们的客场队服是紫色的。

sentences.en: This is Paul Lucas, uniform obsessive and writer of a column at ESPN called UniWatch.
sentences.zh: 这是保罗·卢卡斯，球衣狂热爱好者，也是ESPN专栏《UniWatch》的撰稿人。

sentences.en: It just, it looks so cartoonish and so ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 这真的是，看起来太像卡通了，太荒谬了。

sentences.en: You look at it and it's like, really?
sentences.zh: 你看着它就会想，真的吗？

sentences.en: That's a professional, like, top-level team?
sentences.zh: 这是一支职业的、顶级水平的球队？

sentences.en: The Raptors jersey may have been particularly garish, but it wasn't the only jersey of its kind.
sentences.zh: 猛龙队的球衣可能特别花哨，但它并不是同类球衣中的唯一一个。

sentences.en: The 90s were this insane decade of NBA uniform design
sentences.zh: 90年代是NBA球衣设计疯狂的一个十年，

sentences.en: that produced some of the wildest jerseys that have ever graced a basketball court.
sentences.zh: 它诞生了篮球场上见过的最狂野的一些球衣。

sentences.en: Loud, wacky designs, the likes of which had never been seen before and haven't been seen since.
sentences.zh: 张扬、古怪的设计，在此之前从未见过，此后也再未出现。

sentences.en: Like the Atlanta Hawks' red and black jersey with a fierce-looking hawk swooping in across the entire front of it,
sentences.zh: 比如亚特兰大老鹰队的红黑球衣，整件衣服正面有一只凶猛的老鹰俯冲而下，

sentences.en: holding a basketball in its little talons.
sentences.zh: 它的小爪子里抓着一个篮球。

sentences.en: Or the Milwaukee Bucks green uniform with a giant picture of a purple stag.
sentences.zh: 或者密尔沃基雄鹿队的绿色队服，上面印着一头巨大的紫色雄鹿图片。

sentences.en: Paul Lucas called this one great.
sentences.zh: 保罗·卢卡斯称这个设计很棒。

sentences.en: I mean, great in the sense that it was so awful it was great.
sentences.zh: 我是说，从烂到极致就是棒的意义上来说很棒。

sentences.en: They had this, you know, this purple, garish purple and green color pattern.
sentences.zh: 他们用了这种，你知道的，这种紫色、俗艳的紫色和绿色的配色方案。

sentences.en: But it definitely, all these designs, definitely,
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，所有这些设计，

sentences.en: they pushed and extended the idea of what a basketball uniform could be or should be.
sentences.zh: 它们推动并拓展了篮球球衣可以是什么或应该是什么的观念。

sentences.en: And many of these designs can be traced back to one man.
sentences.zh: 而这些设计大多可以追溯到一个人。

sentences.en: I joined the NBA in 1990 as the league's first creative director.
sentences.zh: 我在1990年加入NBA，担任联盟首任创意总监。

sentences.en: Tom grew up in Chicago, sketching and resketching the logos of his hometown Chicago Blackhawks
sentences.zh: 汤姆在芝加哥长大，不断地素描和重新描绘他家乡芝加哥黑鹰队

sentences.en: and other classic pro hockey teaMs.
sentences.zh: 以及其他经典职业冰球队的标志。

sentences.en: Tom's love for sports and eye-catching art made this new NBA gig a dream job.
sentences.zh: 汤姆对体育的热爱和对引人注目艺术的敏锐眼光，让这份新的NBA工作成为了他的梦想工作。

sentences.en: My first day at the NBA was just filled with excitement.
sentences.zh: 我在NBA的第一天充满了兴奋。

sentences.en: I'd always been a big sports fan and I loved design and I studied graphic design here at Columbia College back in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 我一直是个狂热的体育迷，我热爱设计，曾在芝加哥的哥伦比亚学院学习平面设计。

sentences.en: And so when I walked in the door in June of 1990, I kind of had to pinch myself because I really didn't believe what was happening.
sentences.zh: 所以当我在1990年6月走进那扇门时，我有点得掐掐自己，因为我真的不敢相信这一切正在发生。

sentences.en: Before Tom O'Grady joined the league, most NBA jerseys looked something like that classic Bulls jersey.
sentences.zh: 在汤姆·奥格雷迪加入联盟之前，大多数NBA球衣看起来都有点像那件经典的公牛队球衣。

sentences.en: They had simple two or three color schemes with the team names across the front.
sentences.zh: 它们采用简单的两到三种配色方案，胸前印有球队名称。

sentences.en: There might have been a stripe here or there, maybe a cool font, but that was about it.
sentences.zh: 可能会有一两条条纹，或者很酷的字体，但仅此而已。

sentences.en: And they weren't designed by designers.
sentences.zh: 而且它们不是由设计师设计的。

sentences.en: The process of designing team uniforms was mostly left up to team equipment managers
sentences.zh: 设计球队队服的过程主要留给了球队装备经理，

sentences.en: because they were responsible for getting the players outfitted to play the games.
sentences.zh: 因为他们负责为球员配备比赛装备。

sentences.en: Mostly this consisted of the equipment managers flipping through a catalog
sentences.zh: 这主要包括装备经理翻阅产品目录，

sentences.en: and choosing a design they liked with the right colors.
sentences.zh: 并挑选出他们喜欢的颜色合适的款式。

sentences.en: It was not a sophisticated business, let's say that.
sentences.zh: 这不是什么高端的生意，这么说吧。

sentences.en: They were happy just to get uniforms on the players' backs.
sentences.zh: 只要能让球员穿上队服，他们就很开心了。

sentences.en: But that was all about to change.
Because in 1988, the Charlotte Hornets introduced a radical new idea.
sentences.zh: 因为在1988年，夏洛特黄蜂队推出了一种激进的新理念。

sentences.en: In this archival news footage from 1988,
sentences.zh: 在这段1988年的档案新闻片段中，

sentences.en: Hornets player Kelly Trapuca stands on stage in front of flashing cameras.
sentences.zh: 黄蜂队球员凯利·特拉普卡站在闪烁的相机闪光灯前的舞台上。

sentences.en: Then he rips off his teal tearaway warm-ups to reveal the Hornets' new uniforMs.
sentences.zh: 然后他撕下了青绿色的撕拉式热身服，露出了黄蜂队的新队服。

sentences.en: Teal was not a traditional NBA jersey color.
sentences.zh: 青绿色并不是传统的NBA球衣颜色。

sentences.en: Tom O'Grady had nothing to do with the teal Hornets uniform,
sentences.zh: 汤姆·奥格雷迪和青绿色的黄蜂队球衣没有任何关系，

sentences.en: but he took it as a sign that the league was ready for bolder designs.
sentences.zh: 但他将其视为联盟已经准备好迎接更大胆设计的信号。

sentences.en: It was kind of a leap of faith for the league to say, you know,
sentences.zh: 对联盟来说，这算是一种信仰的飞跃，他们会想，

sentences.en: this is not really something we've seen before.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我们以前没见过的东西。

sentences.en: But as an expansion team, we'll probably let you have this one
sentences.zh: 但作为一支扩编球队，我们可能会让你用这个，

sentences.en: because maybe there's something new we can learn from this.
sentences.zh: 因为也许我们可以从中学到一些新东西。

sentences.en: And it turned out fans loved the teal Hornets jersey.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，球迷们非常喜欢青绿色的黄蜂队球衣。
它看起来清新而与众不同。

sentences.en: They soon became known as the men of teal.
sentences.zh: 他们很快就被称为青绿色军团。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, the Charlotte Hornets had gained great recognition
sentences.zh: 突然之间，夏洛特黄蜂队在打过一场篮球赛之前，

sentences.en: before they'd ever played a basketball game.
sentences.zh: 就已经获得了巨大的知名度。

sentences.en: When Tom O'Grady was hired as the NBA's first creative director two years later in 1990,
sentences.zh: 两年后的1990年，当汤姆·奥格雷迪被聘为NBA首任创意总监时，

sentences.en: he wanted to push jersey design even further.
sentences.zh: 他想要把球衣设计推向更远。

sentences.en: Not just the colors, but the designs on the uniforMs.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是颜色，还有队服上的图案。

sentences.en: Until the early 90s, there had been real limits to how wild you could get with these designs.
sentences.zh: 直到90年代初，这些设计的疯狂程度一直受到真正的限制。

sentences.en: Because all the details, the numbers, the names, and the logos had to be sewn on.
sentences.zh: 因为所有的细节、号码、名字和标志都必须缝上去。

sentences.en: To do any kind of complicated graphics, it would have taken a massive amount of embroidery.
sentences.zh: 要制作任何复杂的图案，都需要大量的刺绣。

sentences.en: And all that thread would have added additional weight and made the jersey hotter to wear.
sentences.zh: 而所有的那些线会增加额外的重量，并使球衣穿起来更热。

sentences.en: But soon after Tom O'Grady joined the NBA, he would get some new tools to work with.
sentences.zh: 但就在汤姆·奥格雷迪加入NBA后不久，他将获得一些用于工作的新工具。

sentences.en: Computer programs like Photoshop and Illustrator helped him dream up new logo designs.
sentences.zh: 像Photoshop和Illustrator这样的计算机程序帮助他构思出新的标志设计。

sentences.en: And there was a new technique to get those drawings onto a jersey.
sentences.zh: 而且还有一种将这些图案印到球衣上的新技艺。
它被称为染料升华转印。

sentences.en: Sublimation is a process of printing dye directly into the fabric.
sentences.zh: 升华转印是将染料直接印入面料中的工艺。

sentences.en: Now for the first time, you could design something in Photoshop.
sentences.zh: 现在，你可以第一次在Photoshop中进行设计。

sentences.en: You could make it big and you could add a bunch of different colors.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它做得很大，还可以添加各种不同的颜色。

sentences.en: Then with sublimation, you could basically print that design straight onto the material
sentences.zh: 然后通过升华转印，你基本上可以直接把设计印到布料上，

sentences.en: without any embroidery or extra weight.
sentences.zh: 而不需要任何刺绣或额外的重量。

sentences.en: So it allowed us to start to take things we would never normally even consider doing on
sentences.zh: 所以这让我们开始尝试做一些我们平时做梦也不会在球衣上考虑的事情。

sentences.en: And we started doing more outrageous uniforms and stuff because we could.
sentences.zh: 我们开始制作更多离谱的队服和东西，因为我们能做到。
我们能做到，所以我们就会去做。

sentences.en: Tom's first big design was for the Phoenix Suns, who were celebrating their 25th year in
sentences.zh: 汤姆设计的第一个重大项目是菲尼克斯太阳队，当时他们正在庆祝加入联盟25周年。

sentences.en: They were moving into a new arena and they wanted a new look.
sentences.zh: 他们要搬进一个新的球馆，并想要一个新的面貌。

sentences.en: So Tom met with their team owner, Jerry Colangelo.
sentences.zh: 于是汤姆与他们的球队老板杰里·科朗杰洛见了面。
他是同乡，也是芝加哥人。

sentences.en: So as soon as he heard my accent, he's like, I think we're going to get along.
sentences.zh: 所以他一听到我的口音，就说，我觉得我们会相处得很好。

sentences.en: You know, I think us Chicago guys kind of get this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我觉得我们芝加哥人挺懂这个的。

sentences.en: Here's what I want to do.
I want to have a logo that's going to last for the next 25 years.
sentences.zh: 我想要一个能用未来25年的标志。

sentences.en: I don't want to have to change it.
So I want something futuristic, but classic.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要一些既具有未来感又经典的东西。

sentences.en: So Tom and his team start in on the Suns redesign.
sentences.zh: 于是汤姆和他的团队开始了太阳队的重新设计。

sentences.en: They come up with this big basketball that's also a Sun.
sentences.zh: 他们设计了一个巨大的篮球，它同时也是一个太阳。

sentences.en: It has these long red to orange gradient sun rays coming off of it.
sentences.zh: 它散发着从红色到橙色渐变的漫长太阳光芒。

sentences.en: And then they print this and a bright purple background onto their new jersey.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把这个和亮紫色的背景印在了他们的新球衣上。

sentences.en: It's not exactly what I would call classic, but it is bold.
sentences.zh: 这不完全是我所说的经典，但它确实很大胆。

sentences.en: As luck would have it, the Phoenix Suns made it to the NBA Finals that year.
sentences.zh: 天意弄人，菲尼克斯太阳队在那一年打入了NBA总决赛。

sentences.en: And the whole country got to see that bright purple jersey with its blazing basketball sun
sentences.zh: 全国观众都在全国电视上看到了那件带有耀眼篮球太阳的亮紫色球衣。

sentences.en: We got exposure for that uniform that was priceless.
sentences.zh: 那款队服获得了无价的曝光度。

sentences.en: We were able to do things with uniforms that we could not imagine even two years before that.
sentences.zh: 我们能够用球衣做出甚至在两年前都无法想象的事情。

sentences.en: Like a teal Detroit Pistons jersey with a flaming horsehead logo
sentences.zh: 比如印有火焰马头标志的青绿色底特律活塞队球衣，

sentences.en: or a pinstriped Houston Rockets jersey featuring a cartoon rocket with an angry face on it.
sentences.zh: 或者带有愤怒表情卡通火箭的细条纹休斯顿火箭队球衣。

sentences.en: Over the course of the decade, two-thirds of NBA teams got new uniforms
sentences.zh: 在这十年里，三分之二的NBA球队都换上了新队服，

sentences.en: with new logos and new color schemes.
sentences.zh: 带有新的标志和新的配色方案。

sentences.en: There was a lot of teal and purple.
sentences.zh: 到处都是青绿色和紫色。

sentences.en: 3D lettering and oversized graphics were everywhere.
sentences.zh: 3D立体字体和超大图形随处可见。

sentences.en: We looked back on it and said, wow, some of this stuff was pretty outlandish.
sentences.zh: 我们回过头来看，天哪，其中一些东西实在是太奇特了。

sentences.en: But it's okay because that's what was happening at the time.
sentences.zh: 但这没关系，因为那是当时正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: The technology let us go wild.
sentences.zh: 科技让我们得以尽情发挥。

sentences.en: And Tom's boss, NBA Commissioner David Stern,
sentences.zh: 而汤姆的老板、NBA总裁大卫·斯特恩，

sentences.en: gave him the freedom to keep pushing the designs further.
sentences.zh: 给了他自由，让他继续把设计推向极致。

sentences.en: He said, you know, if this is what's selling
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，如果这就是卖得好的，

sentences.en: and if you're telling me this is what's going to work at retail,
sentences.zh: 如果你告诉我这就是零售市场上能行得通的，

sentences.en: Before the 90s, the NBA wasn't doing much with merchandising.
sentences.zh: 在90年代之前，NBA并没有在商品销售方面做太多事情。

sentences.en: If a fan wanted to buy a jersey,
sentences.zh: 如果球迷想买一件球衣，

sentences.en: they had to pay the full cost of a genuine stitched NBA game jersey,
sentences.zh: 他们必须支付一件真正的刺绣NBA比赛球衣的全价，

sentences.en: But with all these popular new designs,
sentences.zh: 但随着所有这些大受欢迎的新设计出现，

sentences.en: Tom and others at the NBA got thinking.
sentences.zh: 汤姆和NBA的其他工作人员开始琢磨了。

sentences.en: Why don't we, you know, have a jersey that we can sell for about $45 to $50
sentences.zh: 我们为什么不设计一款球衣，你知道的，售价大约在45到50美元之间，

sentences.en: that looks similar to the game jersey.
sentences.zh: 看起来跟比赛穿的球衣差不多。

sentences.en: And we saw this business explode, you know, in five years.
sentences.zh: 我们眼睁睁看着这项业务在五年内，你知道的，爆发式增长。

sentences.en: It went from almost like a baseline of nothing
sentences.zh: 它的业务几乎从最初的零起点
发展成为一个价值数百万美元的产业，

sentences.en: largely on the jerseys that we were designing.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上都要归功于我们当时设计的球衣。

sentences.en: The era of outlandish NBA uniforms reached its apex in 1995
sentences.zh: NBA奇特球衣的黄金时代在1995年达到了顶峰，

sentences.en: with that jersey we talked about at the beginning,
sentences.zh: 也就是我们在开头提到的那款球衣，

sentences.en: the one that some people call the Barney design.
sentences.zh: 被有些人称为“巴尼”设计的球衣。

sentences.en: We were told directly by the team owner at the time, John Bitov,
sentences.zh: 当时的球队老板约翰·比托夫直接告诉我们：

sentences.en: I would like the Happy Meal box of uniform designs.
sentences.zh: 我想要一款“开心乐园餐”包装盒风格的球衣设计。

sentences.en: And we kind of looked at him puzzled like,
sentences.zh: 我们当时有点困惑地看着他，心想：

sentences.en: what did he mean by that?
He said, I'm not going to wear this uniform forever.
sentences.zh: 他说：我不可能永远穿着这件球衣。

sentences.en: You know, kids don't eat out of a Happy Meal box forever.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，孩子们也不会永远吃开心乐园餐。

sentences.en: But if you're going to get the kids into your store,
sentences.zh: 但如果你想把孩子们吸引到你的店里，

sentences.en: you're going to win them over.
sentences.zh: 你就得赢得他们的芳心。

sentences.en: If Happy Meal design isn't a term yet,
sentences.zh: 如果“开心乐园餐设计”这个词还没出现的话，

sentences.en: I'm making it one right now.
The goal was to convince hockey-loving kids in Toronto
